data.title: Gas price increase from 1 November 2026
data.summary: Muster Gas GmbH announces a price increase for the "Muster Gas Komfort" gas tariff effective 1 November 2026. The monthly advance payment rises from €96.00 to €109.00.
data.explanation: Your gas supplier is raising its prices because of higher CO₂ certificate and storage levy costs. The price per kWh goes up and your monthly advance payment (Abschlag) rises by €13. You may cancel the contract without a notice period, effective when the price change takes effect. An email is enough. The app shows until when you can use this right. You can compare other gas tariffs before deciding. If you do nothing, the new prices apply from 1 November 2026.
